evidence.source: pret/pokefirered@ce6406d8 data/scripts/silphco_doors.inc: SilphCo_8F_OnLoad calls EventScript_Close8FDoor while FLAG_SILPH_8F_DOOR is unset, closing the barrier; SilphCo_8F_EventScript_Door (a bg_event on every barrier tile that is not a top wall edge, any facing) calls EventScript_TryUnlockDoor, which with FLAG_HIDE_SILPH_CO_5F_CARD_KEY set (the Card Key picked up on 5F) plays the unlock and runs EventScript_Open8FDoor, then `special SetHiddenItemFlag` sets FLAG_SILPH_8F_DOOR (VAR_0x8004)
evidence.opens_by: face a barrier tile and press A with the Card Key in the bag; the door cannot be opened without it (EventScript_NeedCardKey)
evidence.kept_closed: the barrier's top row is a wall edge (impassable) and stays a wall when open
